title: nyctago longiflora
intro: Nyctago longiflora, commonly known as the night-blooming jasmine or long-flowered night-blooming jasmine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Nyctaginaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Nyctago longiflora include sedative and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Nyctago longiflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
